newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia stocks (inventories) fall in Q1.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia stocks (inventories) fall in Q1.

text.p: The value of stocks held by Australian private businesses fell an estimated 2.1 percent, seasonally-adjusted, to A$60.16 billion in the March quarter from the December quarter, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said.
The December quarter value of stocks rose a revised one percent to A$61.46 billion (previously A$61.731 billion).
It also said sales by manufacturers fell an estimated 0.9 percent in the March quarter, while wholesale sales fell by 3.1 percent. All figures are at constant 1989/90 prices.

The bureau said the fourth estimate for manufacturers' expected (current price) sales for 1996/97 ending June 30 was A$179.508 billion compared to a third estimate of A$185.16 billion.
This was 1.4 percent higher than the outcome for 1995/96 of A$177.002 billion.
